problem.label: Sound familiar?
problem.title: This is exactly the chaos of your vehicles.
problem.copy: Receipts, PDFs, odometer notes, and shared keys — none of it lives in one place you can ask.

cards.title: Camera roll ≠ logbook
cards.copy: Receipts and PDFs pile up in photos and folders — never as a searchable vehicle history.

cards.title: What does this vehicle cost per km?
cards.copy: Workshop, fuel, tax, insurance — without a trusted cost per kilometer you're flying blind.

cards.title: When was the last service — and at which km?
cards.copy: Dates and odometer readings live in your head, a chat thread, or nowhere.

cards.title: Documents that don't answer
cards.copy: Policy and manual sit in email. You dig; they never reply.

cards.title: Shared vehicle, no single truth
cards.copy: Partners and family lack one trusted timeline for the same vehicle.

cards.title: What's my real consumption?
cards.copy: Fill-up after fill-up, km after km — without a trusted average you're guessing from the dash, not from your history.

solution.label: The solution
solution.title: One logbook per vehicle — structured, searchable, and yours.
solution.copy: GarIQ keeps events, attachments, and document vault files under your account. Invite co-owners when you need help logging — without turning your garage into enterprise software.

plans.label: Plans & AI
plans.title: Three account tiers. Same app — scales with your garage.
plans.copy: Limits below match the live product (garages, vehicles, sharing, and monthly AI credits). List prices are shown in CHF (primary market: Switzerland); App Store and Google Play charge the local currency in DE/AT. Subscribe and manage your plan in the GarIQ app — this website does not process payments. On Free, your monthly AI credit period starts when you add your first vehicle.
plans.footnote: Monthly AI credits cover OCR, chat insert, Ask (logbook and documents), and related billed AI actions. On Free, scanning your registration before your first vehicle does not use monthly credits; document AI for vault categories other than registration is off. Manual Form insert always stays available if you reach the credit limit. You always confirm before an event is saved. Charged subscription amounts come from the store for your country — not from this page. On Basic and Advanced you can also buy AI credit packs in the app; they never expire and stack on your monthly pool.

items.a: Fuel, charging, workshop, taxes, inspections, general expenses, diary notes, and trips — all tied to a vehicle. Insurance payment events can be logged; current insurance policies and purchase contracts live in the document vault (not via Insert → Insurance for the policy itself).

items.q: What's included in the Free plan?
items.a: 1 owned garage, 1 vehicle, 10 AI credits/month after the first vehicle. OCR for fuel and charge; chat for notes, fuel and charge. Document AI off (except registration scan). No Smart Scan, Smart Insert, or sharing. Manual Form always available. Ask within credits.
No. AI proposes a draft from OCR, Smart Scan, Smart Insert, or chat; you edit and confirm on the draft screen before anything is stored.

A Home hub action: take a photo or pick a PDF without choosing the event type first — available from the Basic plan. OCR infers the type among document-like events, then you review the same draft and confirm. On Free, log with the form or typed OCR/chat for fuel and charge.
The chat twin of Smart Scan (Basic+): describe what happened without picking the event type first — GarIQ infers it and prepares the same review draft you confirm.

items.q: Is there a free trial for Basic?
items.a: Basic can include a free trial (target ~30 days) as a store intro offer on iOS and Android — check the current offer in the app before you subscribe. The website does not run the trial or the checkout.

items.q: What are the two Ask modes?
items.a: Logbook Ask answers questions over events, costs, and aggregates. Documents Ask answers over the vehicle vault and can cite document title and page. Both use the same monthly AI credit pool. Ask does not search the web — only your events and files.

items.q: What happens when AI credits run out?
items.a: AI methods (OCR, chat insert, Ask) are disabled until credits reset or you upgrade. On Basic and Advanced the billing owner can also buy a credit pack in the app — Top-Up Mini 20, Standard 50, or Pro 150 credits (CHF 2.90 / 5.90 / 14.90) — never expiring and stacked on the monthly pool. On Free you upgrade first. Manual Form insert always remains available so you can keep logging.
Free and Basic include 1 owned garage. Advanced can own up to 3. On Basic and Advanced you can invite co-owners, admins, or loggers (no Viewer role in v1); Free has no sharing.

items.q: What happens to my data if I downgrade or cancel?
items.a: Nothing is deleted. Resources over your new plan's limits are marked frozen — visible with an upgrade path — until you upgrade or remove them yourself.

Current policy PDFs and coverage dates live on vehicle Details → Insurance policy hub. Logging an insurance payment is a separate logbook event. Do not use Insert → Insurance as the way to add a policy.
App UI and assistant: Italian, German, and English only — one preferred language in Settings for both.

items.q: Which currencies can I log expenses in?
items.a: You can pay in a currency other than your garage's: GarIQ fetches the day's rate and converts automatically, with no manual override.
On Advanced, export a Timeline calendar year as CSV or branded PDF from the Timeline tab (controls are visible but locked on Free/Basic). Full-account export from Settings is not in v1 yet.

items.q: Can I hand over a vehicle when I sell it?
items.a: Yes. The garage Primary Owner can transfer one vehicle's logbook to another GarIQ account: the buyer gets an email invite and accepts in the app. The buyer needs a paid plan and a free vehicle slot. Only part of the history is copied — maintenance, inspections, and tyre or tuning expenses — not fuel, insurance, taxes, trips, notes, or vault documents. Your copy stays as a read-only sale archive. The transfer is irreversible and cannot be accepted on this website.

items.q: Can I subscribe on this website?
items.a: No. Basic and Advanced are purchased in the GarIQ app via the App Store or Google Play (RevenueCat). This marketing site does not process payments or act as checkout.
